settings.heading: Home & Living
settings.intro: Block-printed cushions, throws, table linens, and bath textiles.

settings.heading: Bags
settings.intro: Hand-embroidered statement bags, potlis, clutches, and everyday totes.

settings.heading: Wellness
settings.intro: Hair oils, shampoo, masks, and body care.

settings.heading: Kidswear
settings.intro: Children’s occasionwear for weddings, festivals, and family gatherings.

settings.heading: Cushion covers
settings.intro: Hand-block printed flowers, cypress trees, and quilted cotton. Mix the scales of your prints, or let one cushion do the work.

settings.heading: Throws
settings.intro: Light layers for the sofa, the end of the bed, or a room with the air conditioning on.

settings.heading: Table runners
settings.intro: A strip of hand-block printed pattern down the table. Add plain plates and leave the rest to the flowers.

settings.heading: Tablecloths
settings.intro: Block-printed tablecloths for a full table, whether it’s dinner for two or a few more.

settings.heading: Placemats & dinner napkins
settings.intro: Placemats and napkins that coordinate without looking identical. Check each set for the number of pieces.

settings.heading: Cocktail napkins
settings.intro: Small hand-block printed napkins, sold in sets of twelve. Keep a stack beside the drinks.

settings.heading: Bath towels
settings.intro: Waffle cotton with block-printed flowers. Find a colour that works with the towels you already have.

settings.heading: Bath sheets
settings.intro: A larger towel in lightweight waffle cotton, with hand-block printed patterns.

settings.heading: Hand towels
settings.intro: Hand-block printed waffle hand towels in pairs, for beside the basin or a guest bathroom.

settings.heading: Face towels
settings.intro: Small waffle towels in sets of four, with hand-block printed patterns to coordinate with the bath collection.

settings.heading: Everyday totes
settings.intro: Woven cotton totes with floral and cypress patterns. Round and square shapes are listed with each bag.

settings.heading: Shampoo
settings.intro: A fresh start for wash day. Explore coconut milk, lemon, and Himalayan herb shampoos, with ingredients and directions on each product.

settings.heading: Conditioners & masks
settings.intro: The next step after cleansing. Choose a lavender conditioner or take a little longer with a rosemary or protein hair mask.

settings.heading: Hair oils
settings.intro: Make time for an oiling. Explore hibiscus and Mystic blends, and find the ingredients and how-to for each.

settings.heading: Body oils
settings.intro: Body oils for a quiet moment in your day. Explore each blend’s ingredients, scent, and massage directions.

settings.heading: Bathing powder
settings.intro: A traditional bath-time ritual with herbs, pulses, and flowers. Meet Snanamrit ubtan and see how to mix and use the powder.

settings.heading: Boys’ occasionwear
settings.intro: Kurta and bundi sets for weddings and family celebrations. Choose an age size on the product page.

settings.heading: Girls’ occasionwear
settings.intro: Embroidered sets, skirts, and cowl dhoti outfits for weddings and festivals. Check the available age sizes.

settings.heading: Antique-handle bags
settings.intro: Hand-embroidered bags with antique-style frames and handles. Look for the carry options on each piece.

settings.heading: Potli (Pochette) bags
settings.intro: Drawstring bags with hand embroidery and tassels. A small companion for wedding and festive outfits.

settings.heading: Round bags
settings.intro: Round bags with hand embroidery and decorative handles. Check each piece for its strap options.

settings.heading: Jute clutches
settings.intro: Jute envelope clutches with hand embroidery. Texture in the fabric, detail on the flap.

settings.heading: Embroidered clutches
settings.intro: Hand-embroidered clutches in silk and other fabrics. Open each product to see its details and carry options.
